title: Glasshouse and Aftermath
author: Juniper Almeida
blurb: Astrid Voss, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
